title: RandomX overview
text: RandomX is Monero's CPU-oriented proof-of-work algorithm. Mining performance depends strongly on cache, memory latency, huge pages and CPU microarchitecture. XMRig is a common RandomX miner.

title: Tail emission
text: Monero's tail emission provides a continuing block subsidy. The protocol's tail reward target is 0.6 XMR per block, alongside transaction fees.

title: P2Pool mining
text: P2Pool is a decentralized Monero mining pool design. A miner can run XMRig against P2Pool, ideally alongside its own monerod node. Sidechains such as mini can suit lower hashrates.

title: monerod RPC
text: monerod provides JSON-RPC and HTTP endpoints for chain height, difficulty, block headers, fee estimates, connection state and other node/network information.

title: monero-wallet-rpc
text: monero-wallet-rpc provides programmatic wallet operations. XMRBot treats wallet state as local and does not transmit seeds or private spend keys to the cloud service.

title: XMRBot wallet safety model
text: XMRBot separates market identity, node identity, payout identity and cold-wallet identity. Read operations are R0; local machine changes are R1; sensitive financial operations are R2 and require explicit user approval. Seed and key export are disabled by design.

title: Compute to XMR router
text: xmr.computer prices CPU opportunities in net XMR per hour. Direct RandomX mining acts as the reserve bid, while adapters can represent Qubic or other permitted compute markets. The scheduler serves the machine owner rather than any one network.
